fields.value: Data for: Condition-dependent, amorphous protein agglomerates control cytoplasmic rheology

dsDescriptionValue.value:
Included data sets:
(1) EM images shown in the manuscript;
(2) 40 nm particle tracks and cell contours obtained in all growth conditions;
(3) 3D protein structures obtained with AlphaFold Multimer;
(4) source data for all figures.
